headline: Climate Change Minister Musadik Malik said on Wednesday the government has allocated $10 million from its own resources for a dedicated Clean Air Fund, as air pollution costs Pakistan 6.5% of GDP.

card.desc: Funded from government's own resources, climate minister says.

caption:
Pakistan has allocated $10 million from its own resources for a dedicated Clean Air Fund, Climate Change Minister Musadik Malik said at the National Clean Air Conference, Business Recorder reports. He said air pollution costs the country 6.5% of its GDP, Radio Pakistan adds.
